ux_and_project_rules.measurement_boundary: Record applicability, obligation, evidence type and verified status per dimension. No universal 3s/5s/two-page threshold; no human comprehension claim from browser speed.

must_clarify_before_design_or_implementa.details: Actual Issue/task ID, raw bytes/ref/time/hash, exact operation, role, objects, trigger, existing flow, desired observable result and exclusions.
Does multi-tenant mean tenant-isolated operation within a selected tenant, or explicitly privileged cross-tenant work? Platform role grants no automatic tenant data access.
Stable R/AC, Given/When/Then, pass/fail and evidence method/environment; success/rejection/empty/no-result/loading/stale/unknown/partial/recovery/protected behavior and retained assertions.
must_clarify_before_design_or_implementa.owner: Design/Task Owner with actual same-version Human review

must_clarify_before_design_or_implementa.details: Current live main/Issue/PR and accepted design; repository/base/head, reviewed_design completion boundary if design is requested, exact allowed/forbidden paths, budget and separately granted Preview/repository-write/implementation/merge/deploy/external-effect authority.

Canonical versioned API/PB/authorization/state/error/idempotency/readback/audit/async contracts and actual accounts/data/environment; missing/unknown retained with Owner and recovery, Mock never marks real dependency available.

batch_permission_and_recovery_requiremen: Menu visibility is not API authority. Pair each Function/action with its own Data Scope; enforce Tenant AND Scope server-side, including list/detail/write/batch/export/background operations.
Do not combine read-all with write-own into write-all. A platform operator does not automatically obtain tenant business access. Local identity/Mock does not prove IAM or DB isolation.

Evaluate text paste/import for rapid selection, or justify non-adoption: parse/validate, normalize/deduplicate, exact match within current tenant and permission, separate duplicates/unmatched/ambiguous/unauthorized without leaking resource existence, Human resolve/exclude.
Make selection semantics explicit: current page/current filter/explicit set; selection never executes. Revalidate after text, identity, tenant, filter or object-version changes.
Before execute show final count/scope, current-to-target difference, applicable fees/quotas/permission/notification effects, irreversible/unknown effects and necessary risk confirmation.
After execute distinguish accepted/queued/running/partial/final/unknown; retain item-level known/failed/unknown results and actual result entry.
Preserve original inputs and operation or pre-known idempotency key; timeout/cancel is not proof of non-execution. Unknown side effects require authorized readback before retry.
Retry only per real idempotency contract and verified scope, never whole-batch blind retry or new-ID replay. Do not invent status endpoints, guarantees, Undo or rollback.

On tenant/identity switch discard stale detail/selection/permissions and prevent old late results or pending commands leaking across tenant context; failure must not fall back to old tenant authority.
Cover revoked permission, disabled membership, entitlement failure, conflicts/concurrency, network loss, partial failure and unknown result; escalation/support path must be real and permission-safe.
Proposed access-context.md paths/error codes/JSON/idempotency shapes remain proposals, not adopted executable contracts.
After two materially identical failures without new evidence stop affected branch, retain evidence/Owner/recovery; obey stricter existing budgets.
